description_overrides.A Kingdom Deluded:
Mandatory, start of each turn. You believe the picked Delusion for the rest of the turn.
  • Turn 1: pick any Delusion: battle traits, or warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield (exception: Defenders of the Kingdom).
  • Later turns, make a delusion roll (D6):
       – 1-2: a different one from last turn.
       – 3-4: the same one as last turn (applies even if its unit was destroyed).
       – 5-6: any one, as on turn 1.
description_overrides.A Splendid Pageant: Run: friendly FEC unit wholly within 12" of a friendly FEC Hero: a run roll of 1-3 counts as 4.
description_overrides.A Glorious Banquet: +1 to hit for combat attacks of friendly FEC units that charged this turn, wholly within 12" of a friendly FEC Hero.
description_overrides.The One True King:
• +1 to run and charge rolls: friendly FEC units.
  • −1 to run and charge rolls: enemy units.
description_overrides.A Majestic Menagerie: +1 Attack for Companion melee weapons of friendly FEC units wholly within 12" of a friendly FEC Hero.
description_overrides.Defenders of the Kingdom:
• Only while this unit is on the battlefield: +1 to charge rolls for friendly FEC units wholly within 12" of a friendly FEC Hero (+2 if set up this turn).
  • Can be picked while this unit is patrolling the borders (no effect until it is set up).
description_overrides.Indulge, My Pretties:
Friendly non-Hero FEC Monster wholly within 12" of a friendly FEC Hero:
  • Can use a Rampage of its warscroll already used by another friendly Monster this turn.
  • Charged this turn with an unmodified charge roll of 9+: Strike-first for the rest of the turn.
description_overrides.Feeding Frenzy:
Target: friendly FEC Hero in combat.
  • Rest of the turn: +1 Attack for melee weapons (Companion included) of friendly FEC units wholly within 12" of it.
description_overrides.Glimpse of Delusion:
Target: visible enemy model within 18".
Victim: enemy unit visible to the target and in its combat range (the target's own unit only if 2+ models).
  • Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons: resolve its combat attacks against the victim.
description_overrides.Miasma of Madness:
Target: visible enemy unit within 18".
  • Until your next turn: each unmodified hit roll of 1 for its combat attacks = 1 mortal damage to it, after the Fight.
description_overrides.Summon Cadaverous Barricade: Set up wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them.
description_overrides.Summon Corpsemare Stampede: Set up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them, more than 9" from all enemy units.
description_overrides.Summon Chalice of Ushoran: Set up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them.
description_overrides.Grasping Hands:
Enemy units in its combat range:
  • Cannot Run or Retreat.
  • Picked to use a Move ability: Move halved (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.
description_overrides.Trampled Underfoot:
Usable in combat. Target: a point on a battlefield edge.
Stampede roll: 2D6 +1D6 per battle round on the battlefield (2D6 when summoned, 3D6 next turn…).
  • Moves up to the roll in a straight line toward the point, through enemy combat ranges. Ends in combat only within ½" of a visible enemy = charged.
  • Each enemy unit passed across: D3, on 2+ that much mortal damage.
  • Charged: + stampede roll to Corpsemare Trample Attacks for the rest of the turn.
description_overrides.Draughts of Delusion:
Target: enemy unit within 6". On 3+, opponent picks for the rest of the turn:
  • Drink Deep: its attacks' weapon abilities have no effect (except Companion).
  • Turn Aside: combat attacks targeting it crit on unmodified 5+.
description_overrides.Shroudcage Fragment:
Targets: up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit.
  • A dice each: beats its Control = Strike-last for the rest of the turn.
description_overrides.Ferocious Hunger: On 3+: +1 to hit for its Companion melee weapons, rest of the turn.
description_overrides.The Grisly Pennant:
Charged this turn. Target: enemy unit in combat with it. Dice > its Control, or a 6 — rest of the turn:
  • −1 to hit for the target's combat attacks.
  • +1 to hit for friendly combat attacks targeting it.
description_overrides.Stronger in Madness:
• Ignore the 1st damage point allocated to this unit each phase.
  • Combat attacks targeting it: no weapon abilities (except Companion).
description_overrides.Shriek of Terror:
Target: enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit.
  • A dice per model: each 6 = 1 mortal damage.
  • 3+ damage points allocated: −1 to hit for its attacks, rest of the turn.
description_overrides.Soaring Terror:
Charged this turn. On 3+:
  • Move 2D6" through enemy combat ranges, must end in combat.
  • D3 mortal damage to 1 enemy unit passed across.
description_overrides.On Rotten Wings: Set up again anywhere on the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units.
description_overrides.Lord of the Marches:
Targets: this unit + up to 2 undeployed friendly FEC units of its regiment.
  • Set up in reserve, patrolling the borders (= deployed).
description_overrides.Trespassers!:
If patrolling the borders. Target: an enemy unit.
  • Set up this unit more than 6" from the target, more than 9" from all other enemy units.
  • Then set up its patrolling units wholly within 12" of it, more than 9" from all enemy units.
description_overrides.Charnel Feast:
Target: visible enemy unit within 18".
  • D3 mortal damage.
description_overrides.Deranged Transformation:
Target: the Gorewarden, visible, wholly within 12".
  • Until your next turn: +2" Move, +1 to wound for its combat attacks.
description_overrides.Set Up the Battlefield:
1: Roll off: winner chooses attacker / defender.
2: Defender sets up objectives (map), then sets up terrain: >3" from battlefield edge and objectives, >6" from other terrain.
3: Attacker picks their territory, and begins deployment.
4: Faction terrain first: the player who begins deployment, then the opponent.
5: Units: alternate Deploy abilities, starting with that player. One has none left: the other finishes.
description_overrides.Deploy Faction Terrain:
Target: undeployed friendly faction terrain.
  • Set up wholly within friendly territory, >3" from objectives and other terrain.
description_overrides.Deploy Regiment:
Target: a regiment with no unit deployed.
  • Deploy all its units in a row, no alternating.
  • Cannot set up units of another regiment (battlefield or reserve) meanwhile.
description_overrides.Deploy Unit:
Target: an undeployed unit.
  • Set up wholly within friendly territory, >9" from enemy territory.
description_overrides.Blazing Onslaught: Special Rule: After deployment, before choosing who goes first: opponent picks 1 non-Faction Terrain terrain feature in their territory = hideout (can never be removed).
